name: Cel comic page
doc: The picture printed as a comic page: cel-shaded into flat tone bands (its own hues, pushed toward the palette by `tint`), bold black ink lines from its edges, solid blacks in the deepest shadows, halftone dots in the shadows and Ben-Day dots in the light tones, on off-white paper. On every bar (or 2, 4) the page re-lays out into new panels: seeded, slanted cuts that slide open with an overshoot, each panel its own shot of the picture, slowly pushing in. Every hit (an onset with none in the `space` beats before it) pops a spiky onomatopoeia burst (two stars and exclamation marks, no text) with speed lines, punches the panels in and knocks the colour plate out of register; the bass swells the dots and thickens the ink, and `bands` (bind it) breathes the tone steps. With nothing picked on this host and `subject` wired, it inks that generator instead of the media fallback.

subject.doc: drawn instead of `in` while nothing is picked on this host (a generator: a cel-shaded subject rather than the soft media fallback)

palette.doc: dark to light: the tones `tint` pulls toward; the bursts take the light end

bands.doc: cel tone steps (fractional values move the thresholds: bind it to make the tones breathe)

ink.doc: ink line width in 1080p pixels (0 = no lines)

detail.doc: edge strength that gets inked: lower = more lines

blacks.doc: lightness below which the shadows print solid black

shade.doc: how far up the tones the shadow dots reach

benday.doc: light tones printed as coloured Ben-Day dots on the paper

tint.doc: pull the tones toward the palette (0 = the picture's own colours)

panels.doc: panel cuts per layout (0 = one splash panel); read at the layout's first tick

relayout.doc: how often the page re-lays out

slant.doc: how slanted the panel cuts are

gutter.doc: paper between panels, share of the screen height

slide.doc: beats a new panel cut takes to slide open

bursts.doc: size of the hit bursts (0 = none)

space.doc: beats between counted hits (onsets closer than this are one hit)

lines.doc: speed lines from a fresh burst

punch.doc: panels zoom in and the colour plate slips out of register on a hit

bass.doc: the bass swells the dots and thickens the ink

wobble.doc: hand-drawn wobble of the ink lines

paper.doc: paper (gutters, highlights, between the Ben-Day dots)
